AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it might not be functioning as expected.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation or system instability.
Review AI system configuration and logs to ensure it is correctly set up to generate learning cycles and opportunities.

recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting the platform's reliability.
